semantic_fragments.content: The RISKS of changing environmental conditions for the CLINICAL THERMOMETER are considered in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS. Guidance regarding the RESIDUAL RISKS is provided in the instruction for use (Refer to Operation Guide).

At least one of the following functions is identified as ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE: accuracy of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER; generation of a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION; not providing an OUTPUT TEMPERATURE.

The packaging of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER and PROBE is marked with: a) MEASURING SITE and REFERENCE BODY SITE (N/A); b) mode of operation of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER; c) appropriate symbol from ISO 15223-1:2016 used for sterile packaging (Table 201.D.2.101, symbols 3-8); d) Symbol 5.1.4 of ISO 15233-1:2016 used for CLINICAL THERMOMETER or PROBE with expiration date (Table 201.D.2.101, symbol 2); e) special storage and/or handling instructions. For a specific MODEL OR TYPE REFERENCE, the indication of single use shall be consistent (No single use).

Instructions for use shall contain: a) a summary of the USE SPECIFICATION as determined for IEC 62366-1:2015; b) MEASURING SITE and REFERENCE BODY of CLINICAL THERMOMETER specified (See chapter 'Intended use' of user manual); c) recommended minimum measuring time and minimum time between measurements for each intended MEASURING SITE; d) RATED OUTPUT RANGE for each intended REFERENCE BODY SITE (See chapter 'Safety Precaution' of user manual); e) the LABORATORY ACCURACY in the RATED OUTPUT RANGE (See chapter 'Product performance' of user manual); f) for CLINICAL THERMOMETERS for use with PROBE COVER: instruction how to apply PROBE COVER and information about behaviour when used without PROBE COVER (No PROBE COVER used); g) mode of operation (DIRECT MODE or ADJUSTED MODE) (See chapter 'Product specifications' of user manual); h) instructions for selection and replacement of INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCES (See chapter 'Setup and operating procedures' in user manual).
